title: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 8 (Special Cases concerning Granting Electronic Fixed Dates)
(1) Where an application for an electronic fixed date is received during weekday working hours, the fixed date shall, unless there are special circumstances, be granted on the same day: Provided, That where the application is received after 4:00 p.m. on a weekday, it may be granted on the next working day.
(2) Where an application for an electronic fixed date is received after 4:00 p.m. on a weekday, the fixed-date granting agency shall notify the applicant, by a method prescribed by Supreme Court Regulation, that the fixed date may not be granted on the same day.
(3) Where an application for an electronic fixed date is received after 6:00 p.m. on a weekday or on a Saturday or public holiday, the fixed date shall be granted on the next working day.
